name: Bryston
usb_vendor_ids_source: Linux kernel USB audio quirk tables, sound/usb/quirks.c (d2636407bf8c, 2026-11-12) and sound/usb/quirks-table.h (e7c66b3e249e, 2026-11-04)
_terms_read_and_they_do_not_forbid_it: bryston.com/terms-of-use, read 2026-11-25 with curl, and the answer is permissive - the first in several brands. What it DOES say: « As between you and Bryston Limited, Bryston Ltd owns all intellectual property rights, including without limitation copyright and trade-mark rights, in all materials on or comprising the Website (“Content”) » and « The Bryston Limited logos are trade-marks of Bryston Limited, and may not be used without the express written permission of Bryston Limited » and « You may not use the Bryston Limited Website for any illegal or unauthorized purpose » and a clause against overburdening the servers. WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY, anywhere in 17 592 characters: no prohibition on reproducing, copying, republishing, redistributing or extracting the content, no anti-scraping clause, no data-mining reservation, no personal-and-non-commercial-use limitation. An assertion that the maker owns the copyright is not a prohibition on use - protection is automatic and needs no declaration, so stating it adds nothing to what already applies. The standing rule asks for an EXPLICIT prohibition on using the information; there is none. The trade-mark clause is honoured by construction: this catalogue stores no images and no logos.
_the_footer_link_is_invisible_to_a_fetch: Worth recording for the next WordPress host. The footer renders the words « Terms of Use » but no matching href exists in the served HTML - the link is built by script - so a grep for href containing term|legal|condition on the homepage returns NOTHING and would have concluded « no terms page ». The page is at the obvious path, /terms-of-use, and was found by probing it by name. A sitemap check did not help either: wp-sitemap-posts-page-1.xml was enumerated and does not list it. ON A WORDPRESS HOST, PROBE /terms-of-use AND /terms BY NAME even when the footer appears to have no link.
